taskEntryLayout: Personal task entry follows title, repeat, optional schedule or shortcut, submit in DOM and visual order. The compact notes add button stays in the list toolbar before the first task. Check the same eight tasks at 320 by 570 with keyboard activation and Escape.
title: Owner-scoped personal home tasks and read-only source news
feedbackPresentation: Read markers are separate from workflow. Only WAITING with a valid due date before today in Asia/Seoul is overdue. Compact badges and counts preserve existing ticker space; urgency orders overdue, request/answer needed, observing, answered/closed. Top-level dueDate survives omitted details. Original source status and ERP data are preserved.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/2026 execution dates preserve separate completion records. January feedback includes current/prior years independently; empty current-year feedback falls back at most one year. Old records remain visible without NEW. Keys/links preserve actual year/version; coverage provides actual OrderWeek, absent week stays null. Partial year failure preserves successful results.

dnspyEvidence.source: Personal tasks/read marks are independent owner-scoped server files, not nenova.exe ERP actions. Source news reuses existing readKnowledge/loadQuality read functions and source permission predicates; no new SQL or ERP mutation.

storage: data/runtime/personal-home/{sha256(authenticated userId)}.json; owner.json mutex metadata (pid/hostname/token/createdAt), exclusive temp file, fsync and atomic rename, expectedRevision CAS, idempotent requestId/payload hash. Same-host lock recovery requires process.kill(pid,0) ESRCH and a recovery mutex; verified dead directory is atomically quarantined, only lock metadata cleaned. Missing/unknown/live/foreign-host locks fail closed with administrator guidance; release checks ownership token. 16 MiB file, lifetime maximum 5000 rules (not daily executions), 20000 retained mutation request IDs, 500 most recent read markers.
ownership: req.user.userId alone selects storage; optional expectedOwnerId only detects account races and mismatch rejects before any read/write. No delegation/ownerId input.
occurrences: frequency=once|daily|weekly|monthly; legacy weekdays infer once/daily/weekly. Monthly uses the start day and clamps days 29-31 to each shorter month end, including leap years. GET has no mutation. Completion/archive/restore target POST date=original occurrenceDate; archived rows remain available with archived=true. Update changes selected occurrence title and applies future schedule after max(selected date,current KST date), preserving prior calendar records. stop ends future recurrence after that boundary. Pagination oldest-first: limit default200/max500, offset, totalTasks, nextOffset. Dates 2000-01-01 through 2100-12-31. Schedule segments are counted arithmetically; snapshot/complete/archive overrides adjust prefix counts, then binary search and a bounded heap produce only the requested page without materializing all historical occurrences.
feeds: Valid CHECK and CURRENT knowledge remains visible regardless of age, important-first/latest order, limit20. Authorized feedback remains visible regardless of age: current reporting year latest20; include prior year during the January seven-day boundary, or fallback exactly one prior year when current-year valid cases are empty. No unbounded history scan; actual OrderYear/OrderWeek and year-specific sourceKey/link are preserved. Seven days determines isRecent; isNew requires isRecent and unread, while unread independently tracks source revision. 25-second yearly loadQuality cache with in-flight dedupe; failures not cached. Per-year failures retain successful year results and expose feedErrors; failed current-year reads do not trigger empty-year fallback. Source errors never block personal task saves. read accepts only an item in the current authorized feed; no source mutation.
api: GET date/offset/limit/expectedOwnerId; POST action=create|update|complete|archive|restore|stop|read,expectedRevision,requestId,date,taskId,title,startDate,frequency,weekdays,startTime,endTime,shortcut,done,sourceKey,expectedOwnerId. Authenticated active users; private no-store; same-origin check on POST. Response ownerId/date/revision/tasks/totalTasks/nextOffset/guidance/feedback/feedErrors/syncedAt. Only personal files mutate.
feedDetails: Guidance CHECK=확인 필요 and CURRENT=현재 지침; RETIRED excluded; source isKnowledgeId validates IDs. details preserves situation/action/caution/checklist/contact/reviewDate, newline text up to4000. Feedback statusLabel reuses QUALITY_STATUSES; details farms/products/sources[{orderYear,orderWeek,productName,farmName}], relatedSources[same], caseFarm/caseProduct from anchor coverage or case, problem from actual Title, request from provided recent REQUEST only, latestBody/dueDate/recentEvents. Confirm all grouped sources only for exactly one matching case and one inbox matching case.InboxKey, excluding isNew rows; otherwise use exact year+SourceKey anchor. Ambiguous/unlinked group rows belong only to relatedSources labelled individual history linkage unconfirmed. Unique sources by year/week/farm/product, never Title as product. Ticker summary max300: confirmed grouped names preserved when fitting, overflow names use 외N개 and explicit ellipsis; ambiguous groups anchor names only; actual problem/latest; full details bounded by original4000 text limits. Combined feed JSON UTF8 budget1MiB: oldest WHOLE detail objects replaced with {}, detailsTruncated=true and detailNotice directing to preserved source href; never silently cut names or bodies. Existing20items/feed and authorization/year/read/recent rules retained, no extra SQL or writes.
desktopNotes: Installed desktop app provides a narrow always-on-top note window with owner-scoped authenticated task API, add/edit/complete/archive, copy to clipboard, reminder while signed in/running, and a downloadable Windows URL shortcut. Account lock closes note window. No ERP SQL writes.
scheduleAndShortcut: Criteria: docs/plans/task-launch-criteria-1112.md. startTime/endTime optional KST HH:mm, omitted preserves old settings, empty clears, end strictly after start. shortcut null or kind/target/label, web http(s) without credentials, desktop exact current authenticated bootstrap menu validated at launch in main process. Launch never writes personal completion or ERP. Selected occurrence settings update immediately via snapshot, future rule next day; previous dates and owners preserve snapshots. Shared task-settings normalization in server, IPC and UI. Compact 320px content notes/8 rows, home first8 with paging/timeline.
shortcutSearch: Home and notes share a local search input over the authenticated bootstrap menu labels and groups. NFKC/case/whitespace normalization, no network. Filtering preserves the selected href, unmatched search cannot silently save an old connection, Enter explicitly selects first visible result without submitting, ArrowDown focuses native select, Escape clears query before dialog close. Queries are not persisted. Account/menu refresh preserves query and valid selection; switching kind clears hidden search validity. Native Electron smoke plus actual Chromium search/save/reload/no-result/keyboard/280-390px regression.
presentation: Desktop home only: read-only projected staff requests, large monthly overview by default with sorted two-item daily previews and counts; selected Monday-first weekly time-block schedule always displayed below, exact times, overlap lanes and empty-slot prefill, right task/guidance/feedback rail. Main-window close preserves notes; explicit quit/logout closes all. Web dashboard unchanged.
recurringTaskDisplay: Home and notes show one latest scheduled occurrence per rule. Earlier unfinished occurrences remain stored for history but do not accumulate or reappear after latest completion. Calendar and weekly views retain exact date occurrences; distinct rules are never merged by title.
windowsIdentity: Main windows set explicit Nenova taskbar AppUserModelID, relaunchDisplayName, relaunchCommand and a real external app-icon.ico. The ICO is copied as a builder extraResource, never handed to Windows as an asar path. Authentication failures activate the existing login view in its owner window.
feedIsolation: Guidance/quality reads have a 1500ms per-source deadline so slow SQL feedback cannot hold personal JSON task reads/writes past IPC transport deadlines. Pending shared quality loads still coalesce and may fill their cache later; a timeout returns explicit feedErrors and never authorizes an unknown read marker. Existing client last-good feed retention remains owner-scoped. Main bridge returns Korean retryable 503/504 transport results instead of raw Electron TimeoutError, preserving account-generation checks and input drafts.
performance: Home reads one year-scoped SQL batch for cases, original sources, membership and recent events. Empty case years return immediately. The original farm fallback remains specific to the coverage anchor. No annual warehouse/statistics query or ERP writes. One 500ms I/O budget is shared by guidance/quality. Authorized displays can use a previously successful year snapshot for up to 90s while one refresh runs after 25s. Read markers require a fresh snapshot. Personal task records and read markers remain owner scoped. Authenticated GET returns workspace duration in Server-Timing.
